title: Trump Cannot Pardon Lindsay Clancy, but Her Lawyer Asked Anyway
summary: President Trump does not have the power to wipe away the state murder charges Ms. Clancy faces. Her lawyer’s spokesman said the comments were “a statement to the country.”
